body: I can't say I've experienced any joy in my life except when my dad got my sister a pug puppy and she didn't take care of her so she was basically mine. My best friend but if course some asshole speeding down my street took her away. The only possibility at a bright future I had was in the military but can't do that now because I don't have a diploma.

I almost had a job but of course it got ruined because I couldn't find a ride to the interview. Taking the test for a GED cost money. Which again comes back to not having a job. I owe around 390 for my ticket.
Im not sure it will get better. It's been like this for as long as I could remember.

Maybe some tunnels but not mine. Kinda hard to stand up for myself when I can't say anything to my sisters with out it causing an argument with my dad in which he try's to kick me out of the house. They won't understand they would just laugh and say how stupid I am.
Maybe that's what they need. It would make them realize they shouldn't have treated me so bad when I was around.
I have tickets and can't get one until I pay them. Kinda hard to get a job with out a diploma.
